out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed multiple hot holding shelves and drink refrigerators located at concession line island.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: submit an AMENDMENT in PLUS for “CHANGE OF EQUIPMENT”. EHS will follow up on or around 10 days to verify amendment has been submitted.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the exit doors on auditorium 12 exit side. Observed door sweep and weatherstripping on double doors in need of replacement.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. CFM will work on replacing door sweep and weatherstripping at exit door.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Storage Areas/Receptacles, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The trash compactor on the left side of the building is not operational. Observed several garbage bags piled next to compactor on ground.
violations.corrective_action: Storage areas, enclosures, and receptacles for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained in good repair. CFM has compactor repair scheduled for 1/6/26. CFM stated compactor on other side of building is at capacity.

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the refuse container outside the facility. Observed food and drink debris surrounding trash compactor areas.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. EHS recommended regular cleaning of area by staff.
